gates.name: Source, database, browser, and security CI
gates.criterion: Main passes checks, PostgreSQL isolation, browser coverage, dependency review, secret scanning, SBOM generation, and CodeQL.
gates.nextAction: Review and merge codex/recent-changes-catchup, then retain passing CI and Security workflows for the exact resulting main commit. Historical passing runs and local branch checks do not establish readiness for the merged candidate.

gates.name: Local production-path smoke
gates.criterion: The containerized production profile passes media, observability, multi-writer, backup/restore, restart, and 100-client correctness checks.
gates.nextAction: The isolated local production-path checks passed; after review and merge, retain a complete passing Production-path smoke workflow for the exact resulting main commit, including observability, process-loss recovery, backup/restore, and the 100-client restart exercise.

gates.name: Single-VM staging deployment
gates.criterion: A TLS-only single-VM deployment passes configuration preflight and the remote readiness workflow with PostgreSQL, Valkey, SMTP, private object storage, malware scanning, metrics, and tracing enabled.
gates.nextAction: Provision the single-vm-staging GitHub environment and run Staging readiness.

gates.name: Monitoring, paging, and support rehearsal
gates.criterion: For one exact build candidate, production telemetry reaches the selected backend; build-bound synthetic page, warning, and ticket alerts are injected and resolved and reach named responders; a named support rota, incident commander, escalation contacts, and public status, security, privacy, and support contacts are active; and an end-to-end support incident drill exercises triage, escalation, status communication, an applicable kill switch, and closure with operations-owner and independent-reviewer acceptance.
gates.nextAction: Install the collector and Alertmanager templates; configure secret receiver URLs, the named support rota and escalation contacts, and public status, security, privacy, and support contacts; run the confirmation-gated synthetic alert rehearsal; then retain receiver acknowledgements and complete the end-to-end support incident rehearsal for the same exact build candidate with operations-owner and independent-reviewer decisions.

gates.name: Target-region load and soak
gates.criterion: Single-VM staging passes build- and region-matched 50- and 250-client Round and Presentation profiles plus a representative soak, meeting acknowledgement and client-receipt latency gates with no correctness, duplication, leakage, reconnect, or report-reconciliation loss; the exact matrix, runner provenance, target-service saturation evidence, soak, and durable archive are bound in a validated checksummed bundle.
gates.nextAction: Bring an isolated runner online near the selected VM region, run the fixed four-profile Staging readiness matrix and representative soak, build the target-region evidence bundle, complete the target-region evidence template, and attach the validated bundle with runner provenance, all four load artifacts, the soak summary, target-service saturation evidence, and durable archive reference.

gates.name: Off-host backup and restore drill
gates.criterion: Encrypted PostgreSQL and private object-storage backups created with reviewed least-privilege identities are restored onto a clean replacement host in a separate failure domain; machine-validated, checksum-bound manifests and receipts prove complete inventory restoration and the stated RPO and RTO, with operations-owner and independent-reviewer acceptance.
gates.nextAction: Provision reviewed least-privilege backup identities, create encrypted off-host database and media backups, rebuild a clean replacement VM in a separate failure domain, validate the bound backup manifest and restore receipt, and complete the restoration evidence template with operations-owner and independent-reviewer decisions.

gates.name: Manual accessibility review
gates.criterion: Keyboard, VoiceOver, NVDA, 200% zoom, contrast, reduced-motion, and extended-time scenarios are reviewed with no unresolved launch blockers.
gates.nextAction: Run the manual matrix and link the signed review record.

gates.name: Independent security review
gates.criterion: An independent review covers authentication, realtime authorization, replay, XSS, uploads, rate limits, billing, administration, and infrastructure with no open critical or high findings.
gates.nextAction: Schedule the review and record findings and remediation in the security evidence template.

gates.name: Launch-market privacy and legal approval
gates.criterion: Qualified counsel for the selected launch markets approves the privacy notice, terms, consent, retention, deletion, data residency, subprocessors, and paid-beta posture.
gates.nextAction: Select the launch markets, provide the data map and launch documents to qualified counsel, and link written approval.

gates.name: Live billing rehearsal
gates.criterion: Stripe test mode proves checkout, portal, signed webhook delivery, retry idempotency, cancellation, and entitlement reconciliation in single-VM staging.
gates.nextAction: Run the signed replay workflow, then complete a provider-originated Stripe test-mode purchase and cancellation.

gates.name: Protected release governance
gates.criterion: Main requires passing CI and security checks, review, conversation resolution, and blocks force pushes and deletion.
gates.nextAction: Add a second human reviewer, activate the prepared ruleset, pass a normally reviewed canary PR without bypass, and record the ruleset insight.

gates.name: Physical-device and network matrix
gates.criterion: Supported mobile and desktop devices complete QR join, play, reconnect, and report flows on representative Wi-Fi and cellular networks.
gates.nextAction: Execute the device evidence template against single-VM staging.

gates.name: Design partners and observed sessions
gates.criterion: An independently reviewed, machine-validated aggregate proves at least six higher-education and six workplace facilitators are interviewed; at least eight of the frozen primary twelve demonstrate the recurring post-result decision problem; at least three partners per segment run twice; at least ten real sessions are observed; and at least half of eligible checkpoints complete a reviewed diagnostic, intervention, valid linked recheck, and reconciled report loop.
gates.nextAction: Recruit the two segment cohorts; freeze the primary and reserve order; record reviewer-coded eligibility, final dispositions, recurring-problem evidence, timing/connectivity exclusions and attempt denominator, serious accessibility findings, repeat external-deck use, material context-switch interruptions, repeat-run references, and eligible/completed checkpoint denominators; validate the redacted aggregate and obtain research-owner and independent review before selecting the primary acquisition segment or Phase 1 branch.

gates.name: P0 beta usability success metrics
gates.criterion: An independently reviewed, machine-validated aggregate proves that each segment includes at least six eligible first-time facilitators and twenty eligible participants and meets every P0 creation, live-action comprehension, response, receipt, results-discovery, report-comprehension, and Recovery Rehearsal threshold in an accepted usability study.
gates.nextAction: Run the moderated beta usability protocol with the frozen per-segment sample floors and disposition rules, validate the redacted aggregate, and obtain product-research owner and independent-reviewer acceptance of the completed usability evidence record.

gates.name: Signed community release candidate
gates.criterion: A v0.9.0 release candidate publishes signed OCI images, provenance, SBOMs, scan results, Compose documentation, and upgrade and rollback guidance.
gates.nextAction: After every single-VM beta preflight gate is complete, create a signed v0.9.0 tag from main and retain the release workflow evidence.
